# Code of conduct

Kybl's issues, pull requests and discussions are for building a good app together. Everyone is
welcome, whatever their experience, background or identity.

**Please do**
- Be kind and assume good intent. Most problems are misunderstandings.
- Keep feedback about the work, and make it specific and useful.
- Respect people's time: search before asking, and say what you tried.

**Not welcome**
- Harassment, insults, or personal or political attacks.
- Sexualised language or imagery, and unwelcome attention.
- Publishing someone else's private information.
- Spam, or advertising unrelated to the project.

Maintainers may edit or remove comments, close threads, or block people who break these rules. To
report something privately, use GitHub's **Report content** option on the comment, or report it
through [private vulnerability reporting](https://github.com/erikkubica/kybl/security/advisories/new)
if it is sensitive.

Adapted in spirit from the [Contributor Covenant](https://www.contributor-covenant.org/).
